notes.title: Update 1.1
notes.notes:
General


Ukrainian language localization added.

A sleep option and a new associated number have been added.

Emergency service numbers have been added.

(There is usually a moratorium on such numbers, but players try to call them anyway, so they are included)

Localization errors in some texts have been fixed.

Other improvements and fixes.

notes.title: Demo-version of Techno prank is available to play!
notes.notes:
Techno Prank — demo is already available to play!
The demo version includes a prologue, which lasts approximately 30–45 minutes — the perfect amount of time to dive into the atmosphere and get a feel for the game.

Huge thanks to everyone who participated in the beta test — thanks to you, we’ve been able to fix bugs, improve balance, and polish key mechanics. 

Download it, and share your impressions.
This is just the beginning — things are only going to get more interesting from here!
